def-multidimensional-rectangle-and-volume defines vol[a,b] for the closed rectangle [a,b] and gives volume only for closed rectangles. This proof defines C_i' as open cubes, then uses vol(C_i') in steps 3.1 and 4.1 without defining volume or covering cost for open cubes. Using the side-power cost of the closure would repair the notation.

Step 2.1 invokes 1 = sum_{j=0}^m binom(m,j)x^j(1-x)^(m-j), but this item neither proves the binomial identity nor lists thm-binomial-theorem in its dependencies. That theorem gives the real expansion using iota binom(m,j), so the prerequisite and coefficient embedding are absent here.

The current circuit syntax says every gate has arity at least 1, and the denotational semantics says the empty circuit denotes identity. Yet step 5.1 treats every scalar unitary on the one-dimensional zero-wire space as using zero CNOTs. For example, the nonidentity scalar e^(i pi/3) has no exact zero-wire circuit in this model.
